summary: Renames no longer leave unmanaged copies behind, access reviews can be created, and two misleading failures are gone.

fixes.title: A rename renames instead of copying
fixes.text: Renaming a group or Administrative Unit created a second one in Entra ID, leaving the old one unmanaged. The engine now renames the existing object, keeping its members and roles.
fixes.action: Remove by hand in Entra ID the old copy of any group you renamed on an earlier version.

fixes.title: Access reviews can be created
fixes.text: Every run that created an access review failed for lack of permission. The deployment now grants a permission to create reviews of group membership.
fixes.action: Grant the hosting permissions again so access reviews can be created.

fixes.title: A new admin's pass no longer fails runs
fixes.text: When the pass job ran before the new account existed, the run failed. It now waits and issues the Temporary Access Pass on its next run.

fixes.title: Clear answer when guests are blocked
fixes.text: If your tenant allows no guest invitations, PIM Manager now stops at once and names the External collaboration setting to change.
